newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt air travel up 6.1pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt air travel up 6.1pct in April.

text.p: Air travel at Frankfurt airport grew 6.1 percent in April as business and leisure travel picked up, airport authority figures showed.
Demand from companies generated additional traffic for domestic flights which showed a 7.5 percent rise, the monthly Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) traffic report said.
The first two April weeks showed strong demand for holiday destinations in the Mediterranean region due to the Easter holiday period, it added.
